frontmatter.name: backend-verify
frontmatter.description: Run, lint, type-check and test the FastAPI backend in backend/ exactly the way CI does (ruff, mypy, pytest with the right markers, smoke test, docker compose). Use before claiming any backend change is done, when CI's backend-ci workflow fails, when setting up the backend venv, or when asked to start the API / admin panel locally.

frontmatter.name: model-training
frontmatter.description: Train, evaluate, export and deploy the project's ML models: the diabetic-retinopathy EfficientNet-B0 (backend/models/model.pt), the skin-lesion ONNX model (backend/models/analysis/skin.onnx), and the on-device TFLite model. Use when working in training/ or backend/scripts/export_onnx.py, when swapping or upgrading a model, when tuning the quality-gate threshold, or when checking dataset licences.

frontmatter.name: api-contract
frontmatter.description: Keep the HTTP/JSON contract between the FastAPI backend (backend/app/schemas.py, analysis/schemas.py) and the Kotlin app (composeApp commonMain PredictResponse.kt, AnalysisApi.kt, ApiService.kt) in sync. Use whenever adding, renaming, removing or changing the type or nullability of any request/response field, error code, endpoint or header, or when a contract test or the app's JSON parsing fails.
